semantic_authority: Exact inherited authority of each existing controlled record; inclusion does not elevate unaccepted assertions or administrative closure to physical execution.
controlled_inputs_root_algorithm: SHA256 of OFG-EA-MRE3-CANONICAL-V1 bytes of controlled_inputs array sorted by repository_relative_path NFC UTF8 bytes; source file byte hashes unchanged.
full_repository_binding: Git commit BASE cryptographically binds the complete 192-file Git tree; controlled inputs additionally bound by exact-byte SHA256. LFS source identity remains in existing pointer/descriptors; no fresh full corpus roundtrip is claimed.
